title: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a reinforcement learning framework (RLTT) to improve reasoning in Large Language Models (specifically Looped Language Models) and evaluates it on standard mathematical and logic benchmarks. It does not evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
